comment: Blocked startup entry recipe. C files.c:read_wizkit() sets program_state.wizkit_wishing and files.c:wizkit_addinv() reaches invent.c:addinv_core1 -> quest.c:artitouch, whose questpgr.c:skip_pager() guard suppresses Lua initialization and pager output. The JavaScript runtime has no wizkit startup-file route, so this input-only file cannot record that C entry and is not runtime evidence.
